roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Job roles as Wellfound slugs or plain names, e.g. software-engineer, product-manager, Data Analyst. Each role is searched in every location below. Leave empty to list all jobs in the locations.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Locations as Wellfound slugs or plain names, e.g. san-francisco, new-york, london, or remote for remote jobs. Leave empty to search a role in all locations.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Optional Wellfound listing pages, e.g. https://wellfound.com/role/l/software-engineer/san-francisco, https://wellfound.com/role/r/data-analyst (remote), https://wellfound.com/role/product-manager or https://wellfound.com/location/new-york. A ?page=N parameter sets the first page.

maxJobs.title: Max jobs
maxJobs.description: Stop after this many jobs in total, across all searches. Each job is billed as one event.

maxPages.title: Max pages per search
maxPages.description: Listing pages to read per role/location (20 companies, usually 30-50 jobs per page).

includeDescription.title: Include job description
includeDescription.description: Add the full job description (Markdown) to each job. Turn off for smaller datasets.

onlyNew.title: Only new jobs (monitoring)
onlyNew.description: Return only jobs not returned by an earlier run with the same roles, locations and start URLs. Schedule the actor (e.g. daily) for new-job alerts: the first run is a baseline, later runs output (and bill) only new jobs. State is kept in the key-value store "wellfound-jobs-state" in your account.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy (datacenter is enough). The actor switches to a new IP whenever Wellfound blocks or rate-limits a request, and falls back to direct requests if the proxy keeps failing.
